objective: Preallocate ANALYZE schema lookup keys from table-name length.

tasks.title: Preallocate ANALYZE schema keys
tasks.result: ANALYZE schema lookup now uses an explicit-capacity helper instead of format! for schema:<table> keys.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The helper reserves capacity for schema:<table> before pushing known components.
The optimization replaces format! in load_analyze_schema() schema lookup key construction.
Generated schema key bytes, ANALYZE statistics collection, EXPLAIN statistics consumption, and DDL behavior are unchanged.
git diff --check printed the existing CRLF normalization warning for src/execution/analyze.rs while exiting successfully.
